title: SLS vs SOL

checkpoints.label: Checkpoint
stake: SLS loses: Dale owes Henry his PS5.
SLS wins: Dale gets the satisfaction of being right and the glory of winning 🏆

checkpoints.label: Final
checkpoints.stake: Loser owes the other person a case of beer 🍺

settlementNote: Each checkpoint is scored on % return from the agreed start prices. SOL uses its AUD price at 4:00pm Sydney time on the checkpoint date. SLS uses its last ASX close on or before that date. 12 Sep 2027 is a Sunday, so the final uses SLS's Friday 10 Sep close.
